title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Observe the scatterplot carefully. Notice the pattern of the data points. Consider how the function f(x) might transform the x-values to fit the y-values.

title: Considering $$f(x)=-x$$
text: Think about how the function $$f(x)=-x$$ would transform the x-values. Would this transformation allow the model to fit the data points?

title: Applying $$f(x)=-x$$
text: If $$f(x)=-x$$, then the model becomes $$y_i=\beta_0+x_i \beta_1-x_i \beta_2$$. Can you choose $$\beta_0$$, $$\beta_1$$, and $$\beta_2$$ to fit the data points?
